info.name: ICT251 - CampusPulse School Event Noticeboard API
info.description: Tests all five required REST endpoints. Run requests in order. The POST request stores its created ID for the GET, PUT and DELETE requests.

request.description: Expected: 200 OK with success, count and data array.
